title: Related Questions

How this property which can easily be sold for 65 lakh, be distributed to the heirs? Please reply. 2282 views Q. FATWA PERTAINING TO DISTRIBUTION OF WEALTH,ASSETS ETC FTER FATHER'S DEATH 1939 views Q. Wealth distribution 1627 views Q. Recovery of already paid income taxes through future generated interest money. I'm a computer engineer working with a software company in Mumbai. Every year I'm required to pay income taxes to the Government of India from the salary which we earn through our hard work. This money which goes into the payment of taxes is quite substantial. As part of tax savings we do some investments like fixed deposit etc. Over a period of time I get some interest money on my fixed deposit amount. My question here is, would it be right if I use the interest money generated over my fixed deposit money to recover my loss in the form of tax payment. I'll give a scenario to better explain my thoughts: Suppose till the December 2009, I had paid taxes of Rs. 50000/- in total. Now at the start of January 2010, my bank gives me an interest of 30000/- on my fixed deposit money. Can I use this money on myself, with niyat that I'm recovering my 30000/- amount of total 50000/- paid in form of taxes. Would it be jayaz for me. Request you all to please kindly clarify. 2923 views Q. answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 13115 Country: India Title: Asalam alaikum, My eleder brother expired two years ago leaving behind a wife and a minor child. After some period of time recently, the widow (wife of deceased) got remarried. In this point of view we went to Darul Ifta in Hyderabad to know the Sharia Law for the child custody in such situations. They gave us saying that the Child if female shall be with mother and if male then after her remarriage the child until the age of 7 should be with the maternal grandmother if she is alive and later after 7 to the paternal grandparents if she is not alive then the custody shall be for the paternal grand parents. Now the problem is we have been seeking from the widow the custody but they are reluctant to give when we show them the fatwa they told us to keep it aside and they want to have the share from the property (the share of the widow). we have no problem in giving the share we evaluated as be the sharia law and gave the figure how much will it be and later they keep on delaying things with the intention to avoid the cutodial issue of the child. Until now the issue is pending so far we havent seek any assistance from the court. we would like to seek your kind assistance is doing the rightful. Please guide us, and show us path to safegaurd the childs mental conditions as t he mother (widow) took the child with her to his new husband. Guide us how can we enforce the sharia law, the fatwa issued by Darul Ifta. Question: Asalam alaikum, My eleder brother expired two years ago leaving behind a wife and a minor child. Guide us how can we enforce the sharia law, the fatwa issued by Darul Ifta. Answer ID: 13115 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1276/1005=H/1430) There is no wrong in enforcing the Shariah law. The widow should be paid all her share in the property and wealth left by her husband. It is better to invite 2-4 influential and prudent persons to convince her to act upon the ruling of the Shariah. Taking the matter to court should be avoided to a possible extent. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
